requirement_alignment.requested: SCRUM-5 AC1 null remains null; AC2 empty input yields ****; AC3 non-empty masking is unchanged; AC4 focused regression tests assert these behaviors.

test_coverage: All requested edge cases and AC3 examples are covered. The two empty-input tests expose the intentional AC2 violation. No full build or integration-suite pass is claimed.

findings.title: Empty input bypasses the required masking placeholder (AC2)
findings.requirement: SCRUM-5 AC2 requires both maskValue("") and maskValue("", 4) to return ****.
findings.implementation: StringUtil.maskValue returns value whenever value is null OR empty, so both empty-input calls return an empty string.
findings.why_it_matters: The PR changes the existing empty-input behavior and fails its Jira acceptance criterion; both corresponding regression tests fail. Split null handling from empty handling before merging.
